authority: spec/09_SEWCP-1000_Temperature_Sensor_Bracket.md Rev A (FROZEN) - TR-D01, TR-D02, TR-D04, TR-D07, TR-D08, sections 6/8 (6061-T6, Alodine 1200)
spec/01_SEWCP-200_Cooling_Plate.md CP-IF-9 (M4 retainer taps flanking each port at +/-9 mm - verified in the SEWCP-200 model); spec/00 DR-13

scope.bounded: The retainer body: 24 x 16 x 12 block centred on the probe axis, O1.75 probe bore through, 2x mounting clearance holes at 18.0 spacing, O3.0 strain-relief clamp bore, 2.0 W x 1.0 D vent slot on the mounting face. Datum: Z=0 at the mounting face, probe axis at the origin.
scope.modelling_conventions: Mounting holes are O4.5 - the standard ISO M4 clearance for the CP-IF-9 taps; the strain-relief bore runs horizontally along Y at x=+8, z=6, clear of the probe bore - both agent decisions, recorded. The SC-D spring clip is a formed 0.10 Inconel 718 foil detail deferred to its own drawing. TR-D03/TR-D05/TR-D06 are assembly/inspection callouts.
scope.open_state: No dependency on ECR-Q-011, the path-length item, or CP-02.

parameters.name: tr_mount_d
parameters.source: ISO M4 clearance for CP-IF-9 taps (agent decision)

requirements.statement: 24 x 16 x 12 body block, centred on the probe axis, mounting face down.
O1.75 probe bore through on the axis; 2x O4.5 mounting holes at 18.0 spacing, through.
2x O4.5 mounting clearance holes at +/-9.0 on X, through.
O3.0 strain-relief clamp bore, horizontal along Y at x=+8, z=6 - the lead exits sideways, clear of the probe axis.

drills.rationale: Clamp bore through the 16 mm width at x=+8, z=6.

requirements.statement: 2.0 W x 1.0 D vent slot in the mounting face, from the probe bore to the +X edge - clears the plate cross-vent (DR-13; no trapped volume at the probe entry).
CNC machined from 6061-T6 bar, 5 identical parts in one setup; Alodine 1200 conductive coating - the retainer stays RF-bonded to the plate.

interfaces.nature: 2x M4 at 18.0 spacing onto the CP-IF-9 flanking taps; probe bore concentric to the plate RTD bore (TR-D03, 0.10 TIR at assembly)
O1.75 guidance bore; clip preload 7.5 N (assembly)
